[
  "Surgical excision with histologically negative margins is the recommended and first‑line treatment for primary cutaneous melanoma of any thickness, as well as for melanoma in situ.",
  "Surgical margins for melanoma excision should be based on tumor thickness.",
  "Sentinel lymph node biopsy, when indicated, should be performed before wide excision of the primary melanoma and in the same operative setting whenever possible.",
  "When melanoma is suspected, the whole lesion should be completely excised with a narrow (1–3 mm) margin to perform histological diagnosis.",
  "Incisional biopsies can be performed on large lesions such as facial lesions (e.g., lentigo maligna), acral lesions, and genital lesions.",
  "The consensus rate for the primary excision recommendation is 100 % (21 out of 21 participants).",
  "The 7‑point melanoma checklist assigns 2 points for the presence of a blue‑whitish veil and 1 point for irregular dots and globules.",
  "The blue‑whitish veil criterion is a major criterion, while the dots and globules criterion is a minor criterion, together contributing to a total score of 3.",
  "A blue‑whitish veil appears as confluent blue pigment with an overlying white haze on the image.",
  "Irregularly distributed dots or globules of varying size should be identified on the image.",
  "The presence of a blue‑whitish veil and irregular dots or globules are key features of the melanoma suspicion checklist."
]
